profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Homebase
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer with a demonstrated history of working in web develpment. Skilled in Ruby on Rails, Python, Erlang and Javascript. Holds a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering with a focus in Computer Engineering from Rice University.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Homebase makes work easier for 100,000+ small (but mighty) businesses with everything they need to manage an hourly team: employee scheduling, time clocks, team communication, hiring, onboarding, and compliance. Don’t call us Human Capital Management. We’re tools built for the busiest businesses, so owners and employees can spend less time on paperwork and more time on what matters. 
Homebase has been named the top time clock and scheduling software of 2020 by The Blueprint, business.com, Investopedia, and more, and was a gold medal winner of Inc Magazine’s 2020 Best in Business awards.

Check out joinhomebase.com to learn more about how Homebase can help your small business improve team management. 

In my role at Homebase, I’m part of the Billing team, and I’m responsible for developing and maintaining integrations with various payment processing systems as well as our product and subscription management, pricing, and packaging functionality.

Have a question? Send me an email at rachelgreen@joinhomebase.com.

positions.description:

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Develops and tests software and web solutions for various clients.

Creates web and software strategy for small businesses

positions.title: Contract Web Developer
positions.description: Developed and tested portions of a marketplace app using test driven development, agile processes and a continuous integration pipeline.  Marketplace app built in Ruby on Rails.

positions.title: Jr. Software Developer
positions.description: Developed, tested, and deployed micro services in a software-as-a-service back-end, using agile processes and a continuous integration/delivery pipeline.  Application built using Erlang/OTP.

positions.title: Patent Agent
positions.description:
Drafted patent applications for various clients that are then submitted to the USPTO.  

Performed other tasks related to patent prosecution that help move submitted patent applications closer to issuance. 

Conducted clearance and patentability searches that are used to advise clients on business and IP strategy.

positions.title: Accounting Assistant
positions.description: Organized the documentation for the department, including the creation and maintenance of databases.  Maintained contact information for various employees at Rice.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Project Assistant
positions.description: Helping develop new features, and improvements for a website using Ruby on Rails as the primary language and framework. Using the language Asymptote to produce the graphics used in the 800-page course notes for a 300 – level class on signals and systems within the department.

positions.title: Grader
positions.description: Grades portions of fifty-five student homework assignments biweekly for a 300 – level class on digital logic design within the department.

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering

organizations.name: Rice Campanile
organizations.position: Co-Editor-In-Chief, Duncan Section Editor, Copy-editor · Mar 2010 - Present
organizations.description: For my freshmen and sophomore years, I served as the editor for my residential college, Duncan, in which I designed the section of the yearbook showcasing the year at Duncan.  My junior year, I served as one of two editors-in-chief, supervising the creation of the 400 page yearbook.  And in my senior year, I will serve as one of two copy-editors for this year's edition of the yearbook.
